data.content:
Vancouver Whitecaps FC have cooled off. A tie with Los Angeles FC last time out kept their winless MLS skid going, and Tristan Blackmon saw red in it. The defense still holds up, with the second-fewest goals conceded in MLS, and Brian White remains the main threat up top.
